description: From an initial investment and a series of periodic cash flows, compute the simple payback period (the point where cumulative cash flow turns positive), plus the discounted payback period when a discount rate is supplied. Pure arithmetic over a running cumulative sum, no live rate feed.

cashFlows.description: Net cash flow for each period, in order

discountRatePercent.description: Optional discount rate per period, as a percent; when provided, also computes the discounted payback period

initialInvestment.description: The initial investment amount (must be greater than zero)

name: calculate_payback_period
